result.quote: the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city
result.reason: The key is supported by verse 30, where the prophet lays the body in his own tomb. However, the broad question also permits several other actions stated in verse 29: he lifts the body, places it on the donkey, and brings it to his city. The wording should specify that it is asking where he ultimately lays or buries the body.
